name: Visa VSDC ATM Cash Disbursement Checking Account Profile
disclaimer: ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDER RULES FOR INTERNAL SIMULATOR VALIDATION. PENDING FORMAL APPROVED INTERNAL NETWORK SPECIFICATIONS.

rules.userMessage: Card PAN is mandatory for ATM cash disbursement request.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Ensure test card PAN is mapped in DE 2.

rules.userMessage: Processing code must specify Cash Withdrawal from Checking (010000).
POS Entry Mode indicates reading capability and PIN capability.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Set DE 22 to '0510' (05=Integrated Circuit Card, 1=PIN capable).

rules.userMessage: Encrypted PIN block DE 52 is required for ATM cash withdrawal with chip & PIN.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Inject encrypted ISO format 0/4 PIN block in DE 52.

rules.ruleName: Integrated Circuit Card (ICC) System Related Data
rules.userMessage: Chip entry requires DE 55 BER-TLV block containing terminal and card cryptograms.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Attach valid EMV TLV buffer to DE 55.

rules.userMessage: Tag 9F26 (ARQC) is mandatory within DE 55 for online chip transaction verification.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Ensure terminal simulator generates tag 9F26 in DE 55.

rules.userMessage: Tag 9F36 (ATC) is mandatory for CAM replay prevention.
Visa-specific terminal data in DE 60 is required.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Add DE 60 containing terminal type and chip condition code.

rules.userMessage: DE 39 (Response Code) must not be populated in an authorization request (0100).
rules.suggestedCorrection: Remove DE 39 from outgoing request message.
